title: Reset Operator Stats Data to Zero on the VISU_DATA Screen
summary: Use the DATA RESET button in the Operator Stats section on the Operator Station HMI VISU_DATA screen to clear the operator response-time metrics (left and right) back to zero.
when_to_use: When the Operator Stats response-time metrics on the VISU_DATA screen need to be cleared (reset) to zero using the Operator Stats section DATA RESET button.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate to the VISU_DATA screen on the Operator Station HMI and press the Operator Stats DATA RESET button; verify the response-time fields reset to zero.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (Operator Station HMI)

access_required: Access to the Operator Station HMI to view the VISU_DATA screen and press the DATA RESET button in the Operator Stats section.

visual_references.description: Operator Station HMI Data Screen—Operator Stats section showing Resp Time Max (ms), Resp Time Min (ms), Resp Time Avg (ms) for left/right tippers and the DATA RESET button.

steps.title: Open the VISU_DATA screen on the Operator Station HMI
steps.purpose: Get to the screen that contains the Operator Stats section and its DATA RESET button.
steps.instruction: On the Operator Station HMI, navigate to the VISU_DATA screen (Operator Station HMI Data Screen).
steps.expected_result: The VISU_DATA screen is displayed and the Operator Stats section is visible.
steps.healthy_condition: Operator Stats section is visible on VISU_DATA with response-time fields for left and right tippers.
steps.failure_condition: VISU_DATA is not displayed or the Operator Stats section is not visible.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 4.1.2.2: VISU_DATA SCREEN describes the Operator Station HMI Data Screen and its components.

steps.title: Locate the Operator Stats section and DATA RESET button
steps.purpose: Identify the exact control used to reset the operator response-time metrics.
steps.instruction: Locate the Operator Stats section on the VISU_DATA screen and find the DATA RESET button within that section.
steps.expected_result: The Operator Stats section is located and the DATA RESET button is visible.
steps.healthy_condition: Operator Stats section shows Resp Time Max (ms), Resp Time Min (ms), and Resp Time Avg (ms) for both left and right tippers, and the DATA RESET button is present.
steps.failure_condition: DATA RESET button is not present/visible in the Operator Stats section.

actions.label: Identify Operator Stats controls
actions.exact_action: Locate the "Operator Stats" section and its "DATA RESET" button

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-21 / Operator Stats section: Resp Time Max (ms), Resp Time Min (ms), Resp Time Avg (ms) for left/right; DATA RESET button resets operator stats data to zero.

steps.title: Press DATA RESET to reset operator stats to zero
steps.purpose: Clear the operator response-time metrics displayed on VISU_DATA back to zero.
steps.instruction: Press the DATA RESET button in the Operator Stats section.
steps.expected_result: The Operator Stats response-time metrics reset to zero on the VISU_DATA screen.
steps.healthy_condition: Resp Time Max (ms), Resp Time Min (ms), and Resp Time Avg (ms) for both left and right tippers display reset-to-zero values after the button press.
steps.failure_condition: Operator Stats response-time fields do not reset to zero after pressing DATA RESET.

actions.label: Reset operator stats
actions.exact_action: Press this button to reset the data to zero.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Operator Stats values do not reset to zero, stop and escalate for support rather than repeatedly pressing the reset.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Operator Stats section includes a DATA RESET button to reset the operator stats data to zero (Figure 4-21).

steps.title: Verify response-time fields reset to zero (left and right)
steps.purpose: Confirm the reset took effect by checking the displayed metrics.
steps.instruction: Verify that the Operator Stats response-time fields show reset-to-zero values for both left and right tippers: Resp Time Max (ms), Resp Time Min (ms), and Resp Time Avg (ms).
steps.expected_result: Resp Time Max (ms), Resp Time Min (ms), and Resp Time Avg (ms) for both left and right tippers display zero values as shown on the VISU_DATA screen.
steps.healthy_condition: All six response-time fields (left/right for Max/Min/Avg) are at zero after the reset.
steps.failure_condition: One or more of the response-time fields remain non-zero after the reset.

actions.label: Check reset values
actions.exact_action: Verify the Operator Stats response-time fields (Resp Time Max (ms), Resp Time Min (ms), Resp Time Avg (ms) for left and right) show reset-to-zero values

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Operator Stats values do not reset to zero, stop and escalate for support rather than repeatedly pressing the reset.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Operator Stats fields are Resp Time Max (ms), Resp Time Min (ms), Resp Time Avg (ms) for left/right; DATA RESET button resets operator stats data to zero.

healthy_conditions: Operator Stats section shows zero values for Resp Time Max (ms), Resp Time Min (ms), and Resp Time Avg (ms) for both left and right tippers after reset.
failure_conditions: Operator Stats response-time fields do not reset to zero after pressing DATA RESET.
escalation_guidance: If the Operator Stats values do not reset to zero, stop and escalate for support rather than repeatedly pressing the reset.
